name: InfiniSplat v2
definition: A feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction method for arbitrary input views that decouples geometry and attribute prediction, uses ground-truth (GT) camera poses for alignment during training, and employs large-angle target view supervision to improve rendering quality under large viewpoint changes.
summary: InfiniSplat v2 is a feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction method that decouples geometry and attribute prediction, freezing the geometry branch to prevent degradation and using ground-truth poses for alignment.
